title: This was fantastic. This...
text: This was fantastic. This was the absolute perfect excursion. I was worried it would just be a loop around and back but you actually get to sit on the water and watch the sunset. 10/10
author: Jessica_A

title: Sunset at Sea
text: Sunsets on the sea don't get any better than this. With Phillipe as your captain? A glass of champagne in one hand and snacks at bay. Cheers. 😎👍
author: Boyd_D

title: Great experience to see Barcelona from the sea
text: Great sailboat tour during sunset. Easy to find boat with given instructions. Nicest captain (Phillipe), who was also bartender and deckhand. Great time to go (mid-Oct) when it's not too hot or too cold. Highly recommended.
author: George_S

title: Sunset sailing
text: It was a wonderful time. Luis was a great guy. Lots of energy and very sociable. The snacks were a nice added thing and we were in great hands. The Cava was an added touch. The night was so relaxing and the sunset made it romantic. It was nice to have a seat to sit on rather than having to get in mats
author: Charline_C

title: Beautiful Ride
text: We had a fabulous time with Violetta! Loved the chance to go swimming in the sea. …………………………………………..

title: The trip was perfect....

title: Sunset cruise

title: Perfect eclipse experience!
text: Liz was an excellent captan. We went for the eclipse, she provided us with eclipse glasses and an eclipse phone camera lens, which was awesome and unexpected. Also played awesome music. Beautiful tour regardless of the day, but ideal for this special occasion. Would book again!
